title: C++ Tutorial: From Source to Program

titleI18n.zh-Hant: C++ 教程：由原始碼到程式

description: What C++ is, how a program is built, and the smallest complete C++ program. This is the orientation chapter of the course.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: C++ 是甚麼、程式如何建置，以及最小的完整 C++ 程式。這是課程的導覽章節。

questions.prompt: Which header must be included to use std::cout?

prompt.zh-Hant: 要使用 std::cout，必須包含哪一個標頭檔？

explanation.zh-Hant: std::cout 定義在 <iostream>；<fstream> 處理檔案串流，<string> 是字串類別，<cstdio> 提供 C 風格的 printf。

questions.explanation: std::cout is declared in <iostream>. <fstream> handles file streams, <string> defines std::string, and <cstdio> exposes the C-style printf family.

questions.prompt: Which function is the entry point of every C++ program?

prompt.zh-Hant: 每一個 C++ 程式的進入點是哪一個函式？

explanation.zh-Hant: 程式由 main 開始執行；其他名稱只是普通函式，作業系統不會自動呼叫。

questions.explanation: Execution starts at main. Other names are ordinary functions and are never called by the runtime unless your code calls them.

questions.prompt: A C++ program is normally compiled into a native executable.

prompt.zh-Hant: C++ 程式通常會被編譯成原生執行檔。

explanation.zh-Hant: C++ 是編譯式語言：編譯器把原始碼轉成目的碼，連結器再產生平台的原生執行檔。

questions.explanation: C++ is a compiled language: the compiler turns source into object code and the linker produces a native executable for the target platform.

questions.prompt: C++ source code is usually executed directly by the operating system without a compilation step.

prompt.zh-Hant: C++ 原始碼通常由作業系統直接執行，不需要編譯步驟。

explanation.zh-Hant: 作業系統執行的是機器碼，不是 .cpp 文字檔；必須先編譯（及連結）。

questions.explanation: The OS runs machine code, not a .cpp text file. The source must first be compiled and linked (or run through an interpreter such as Cling).

questions.prompt: Which of these start a comment in C++? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些可以開始一段 C++ 註釋？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: // 註釋到行尾，/* ... */ 註釋一個區塊；# 是前置處理器指示，<!-- --> 不是 C++ 語法。

questions.explanation: // comments to the end of the line and /* ... */ comments a block. # starts a preprocessor directive, and <!-- --> is not C++ syntax.

questions.prompt: Which of these are standard C++ library headers? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是 C++ 標準程式庫的標頭檔？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: <iostream>、<vector>、<string> 都是標準標頭；C++ 標準庫沒有 <python>。

questions.explanation: <iostream>, <vector> and <string> are all standard headers. There is no <python> header in the C++ standard library.

questions.prompt: The operator used with std::cout to send data to the console is ____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 配合 std::cout 把資料送到主控台的運算子是 ____。

explanation.zh-Hant: << 是插入運算子；std::cout << value 會把 value 寫入輸出串流。

questions.explanation: << is the stream insertion operator: std::cout << value writes value to the output stream.

questions.prompt: Every C++ program begins execution at the function named ____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 每一個 C++ 程式都從名為 ____ 的函式開始執行。

explanation.zh-Hant: 標準規定程式從 main 開始；它可以有參數，但名稱必須是 main。

questions.explanation: The standard requires execution to begin at main. It may take parameters, but its name is fixed.

questions.prompt: In one or two sentences, explain the difference between compiling and interpreting a program.

prompt.zh-Hant: 用一至兩句說明「編譯」與「解譯」執行程式的分別。

model.zh-Hant: 編譯器先把整份原始碼翻譯成機器碼，產生可獨立執行的執行檔；解譯器則在執行時逐句翻譯並立即執行，通常較慢但不用事先建置。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵差異在於翻譯發生的時機：執行前（編譯）還是執行中（解譯）。

answer.model: A compiler translates the whole source into machine code before the program runs, producing a standalone executable; an interpreter translates and executes statements while the program runs, which is usually slower but needs no build step.

questions.explanation: The key difference is when translation happens: ahead of execution (compiler) or during execution (interpreter).

questions.prompt: What does returning 0 from main conventionally signal to the operating system?

prompt.zh-Hant: main 回傳 0 通常向作業系統表示甚麼？

explanation.zh-Hant: 依慣例，0 代表成功，非零值代表某種錯誤；shell 可用 $? 讀取。

options.text: The program has no return type

questions.explanation: By convention 0 means success and a non-zero value reports an error; a shell can read it through $?.
